narrative.intro: Thalle Construction has $1.9B in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction received 3 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $640M and obligations up 572.6% year over year. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, obligating $1.9B to Thalle Construction. The Department of the Interior is a much smaller buyer, obligating $239K. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the principal market for Thalle Construction at $1.9B, while Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $239K. Historical obligations show variation across years: FY21 $167M, FY22 $213M, FY23 $16.1M, FY24 $366M, FY25 $285M, and FY26 $1.9B. Current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables where noted as total contract values.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Thalle Construction's federal revenues?
sections.body: The Department of Defense accounts for $1.9B of Thalle Construction's FY2026 obligations. Other agencies are minimal by comparison, with the Department of the Interior at $239K. The primary NAICS market is Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $1.9B, showing that revenue is highly concentrated by both buyer and market.

sections.heading: How has Thalle Construction's federal business trended recently?
sections.body: FY26 obligations stand at $1.9B, up 572.6% year over year. Annual obligations varied: FY21 $167M, FY22 $213M, FY23 $16.1M, FY24 $366M, FY25 $285M, and FY26 $1.9B. The increase in FY26 is reflected in the current count of 3 awards with an average award size of $640M.

faq.q: How much does Thalle Construction make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Thalle Construction has $1.9B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction received 3 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $640M. Historical obligations by year were FY21 $167M, FY22 $213M, FY23 $16.1M, FY24 $366M, and FY25 $285M.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Thalle Construction?
faq.a: The Department of Defense buys most from Thalle Construction, obligating $1.9B in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior is also a listed buyer, obligating $239K.

faq.q: What does Thalle Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Thalle Construction sells heavy and civil engineering construction services. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the top NAICS market at $1.9B. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction is a secondary market at $239K.
